account_number_masked.suggestion: No action needed; refer to the source document for full numbers.

ambiguous_wikilink.suggestion: Use full paths in wikilinks to disambiguate.

amount_corrected_by_reconciliation.suggestion: Verify the corrected amount against the source document.

api_error_payload.suggestion: Check the API URL, authentication and query parameters.

api_fallback_html.suggestion: Configure the platform API credentials for complete, stable extraction.

archive_bomb_suspected.suggestion: Extract the files you need locally and upload them individually.

archive_encrypted.suggestion: Provide the archive password, or upload an unencrypted archive.

archive_entry_skipped.suggestion: Repack the archive with plain relative paths and upload it again.

archive_path_rejected.suggestion: Repack the archive with relative paths and no symlinks.

archive_truncated.suggestion: Upload fewer files per archive, or raise the archive limits when self-hosting.

asr_confidence_low.suggestion: Upload a cleaner recording, or retry with a larger ASR model.

asr_hallucination_filtered.suggestion: Check the flagged timestamps against the audio if you need every word.

attachment_failed.suggestion: Extract the attachment and convert it on its own to see the specific error.

attachment_skipped.suggestion: Extract the attachment and convert it separately if you need its content.

attachment_unconverted.suggestion: Extract the named attachment and convert it separately.

best_effort_extraction.suggestion: Verify key fields against the source, or use an official export.

bibtex_duplicate_keys.suggestion: Rename the duplicate keys in the .bib file.

boilerplate_removed_corpus.suggestion: Turn off corpus boilerplate removal in site options if you need that text.

browser_asr_small_model.suggestion: Choose a larger browser model, or convert on the server for better accuracy.

calibre_missing.suggestion: Install Calibre so ebook-convert is on PATH, or convert the book to EPUB first.

captions_only.suggestion: Request ASR in options if the captions are poor or missing words.

cell_errors.suggestion: Fix the errors in the source workbook; error cells are kept as-is.

chapters_generated.suggestion: Check chapter boundaries and titles; add chapters at the source to use them instead.

chat_screenshot_decorations_removed.suggestion: No action needed; crop the screenshot yourself if something was wrongly removed.

clippings_deduped.suggestion: Check merged highlights if you edited a highlight and expected both versions.

columns_swapped_by_reconciliation.suggestion: Verify the column assignment against the source document.

columns_truncated.suggestion: Select the columns you need in options, or use the CSV export.

combined_too_large.suggestion: Use per-page output or the rag profile instead of one combined file.

comments_collapsed.suggestion: Raise the comment depth option to include collapsed branches.

comments_present.suggestion: Set track_changes=all to render comments inline at their anchors.

comments_truncated.suggestion: Raise the comment limit in options, or configure the platform API key.

connection_string_refused.suggestion: Export the data to a file such as CSV or SQLite and upload that.

content_type_mismatch.suggestion: Check the URL serves the intended file, or pass --format to force a converter.

converter_failed.suggestion: Check the sidecar for the error detail, try another engine, or report the file.

copy_restricted_ignored.suggestion: Make sure you have the right to extract text from this document.

date_order_assumed.suggestion: Pass the date order (DMY or MDY) in options to match the export's locale.

dates_from_filesystem.suggestion: Add created and updated dates to the notes' frontmatter.

deloop.suggestion: Check the marked segments against the audio; a larger model loops less.

depth_truncated.suggestion: Raise the depth limit in data options.

diarization_skipped_cpu_budget.suggestion: Force diarization in options, or run on a GPU or a hosted backend that includes it.

diarization_skipped_short.suggestion: No action needed; force diarization in options if the clip has several speakers.

diarization_unavailable_offload.suggestion: Use a local or diarizing backend (e.g. Deepgram), or upload a shorter clip that stays local.

discord_package_no_authors.suggestion: Use a channel export tool that includes author names for full attribution.

drm_protected.suggestion: Use a DRM-free copy of the book.

duplicate_row_at_page_break.suggestion: Check the page break in the source if row counts look off.

duration_cap_exceeded.suggestion: Split the audio into shorter parts, or self-host to remove the cap.

duration_limit_reached.suggestion: Trim the file into shorter parts, or self-host with a higher duration limit.

empty_body_js_required.suggestion: Enable the browser rendering engine, or convert the page with the browser extension.

encoding_uncertain.suggestion: Re-save the file as UTF-8 or pass the source encoding in options.

encrypted_content.suggestion: Decrypt the content in its source app and export it again.

encrypted_no_password.suggestion: Provide the password in the PDF options or upload an unencrypted copy.

engine_failed.suggestion: Retry with another engine via --engine family=name, or report the file with a fixture.

engine_fallback.suggestion: Check engine_trace in the sidecar for the failure, or pick an engine with --engine family=name.

env_values_redacted.suggestion: No action needed; share values through a secret manager, not converted output.

epub_mimetype_missing.suggestion: Re-export the EPUB with a compliant tool if other readers reject it.

equation_as_text.suggestion: Use an engine with formula recognition if you need LaTeX output.

equation_partial.suggestion: Compare equations with the source; DOCX with native equations converts best.

equation_unrecognized.suggestion: Use an engine with formula recognition, e.g. --engine pdf=docling, or a GPU OCR tier.

experimental_converter.suggestion: Review the output closely and report problems so the converter can graduate.

extra_required.suggestion: Install the extra named in the message, e.g. pip install 'intomd[docs]'.

extraction_empty.suggestion: If the source is scanned or image-only, enable OCR; otherwise confirm the file is not empty.

fetch_blocked.suggestion: Download the content in your browser and upload it, or use the browser extension.

fetch_blocked_by_platform.suggestion: Upload the file directly, or install the browser extension to fetch from your own connection.

fetch_blocked_by_policy.suggestion: Use the browser extension or share sheet, or upload the file directly.

fetch_degraded.suggestion: Retry later, or upload the file directly for complete content.

fetch_failed.suggestion: Check the URL and that the site is up, then retry.

fetch_refused_private_network.suggestion: Use a public URL, or upload the file; self-host to convert intranet URLs.

fetch_refused_scheme.suggestion: Use an http or https URL, or upload the file directly.

fetched_partial.suggestion: Retry, or download the content in your browser and upload it.

fillers_removed.suggestion: Enable verbatim mode to keep filler words.

first_sheet_only.suggestion: Download the spreadsheet as XLSX and upload it to convert every sheet.

formula_uncalculated.suggestion: Open and save the workbook in Excel or LibreOffice to compute values, then reconvert.

formulas_present.suggestion: Set formulas=false in options if you only want computed values.

fulltext_unavailable.suggestion: Upload the full-text PDF, or use an open-access link.

heading_depth_clamped.suggestion: Use per-page output to keep each page's original heading depth.

heading_inferred_from_formatting.suggestion: Apply Heading styles in the source document for reliable structure.

heading_source_structure_tree.suggestion: No action needed; edit the PDF's tags in the authoring tool to change headings.

hidden_sheets_included.suggestion: Turn off hidden sheet inclusion in the spreadsheet options to omit them.

hidden_slides_included.suggestion: Turn off hidden slide inclusion in the presentation options to omit them.

http_error.suggestion: Check the URL opens in a browser, then retry; the message has the status code.

image_skipped.suggestion: Enable image OCR or description in options if the image carries information.

image_too_large.suggestion: Downscale the image below 50 megapixels and reconvert.

images_without_alt.suggestion: Enable image description or OCR if the images carry information.

injection_suspected.suggestion: Treat the flagged text as untrusted and review sidecar injection_findings before using it.

invoice_validation_failed.suggestion: Check line items, tax and totals against the source invoice.

iwork_preview_fallback.suggestion: Export from Pages, Numbers or Keynote to DOCX, XLSX or PPTX and convert that.

ixt_format_unknown.suggestion: Check the flagged facts by hand; upgrade intomd in case the format was added.

json_repaired.suggestion: Fix the source JSON; repaired values may differ from what was intended.

kindle_clip_limit.suggestion: Copy the full passage from the book itself; the export cannot recover it.

language_uncertain.suggestion: Pass --lang with the correct language code and reconvert.

latex_main_ambiguous.suggestion: Name the main .tex file explicitly in the LaTeX options.

latex_unknown_macro.suggestion: Include the .sty or macro definitions in the upload so they can be expanded.

layout_ocr_unavailable_cpu.suggestion: Run on a host with a GPU, or install a CPU-capable layout model, for complex layouts.

lazy_content_possible.suggestion: Enable browser rendering, or convert with the extension after scrolling to the end.

legacy_text_only.suggestion: Save the file as DOCX, XLSX or PPTX and reconvert.

libreoffice_missing.suggestion: Install LibreOffice so soffice is on PATH, then reconvert.

license_restricted_engine_used.suggestion: Check the engine license allows your use, or unset INTOMD_ALLOW_RESTRICTED_MODELS.

llms_txt_may_be_stale.suggestion: Crawl via the sitemap instead of llms.txt to get current pages.

llms_txt_used.suggestion: Pass a sitemap URL or explicit URL list to crawl a different set of pages.

log_lines_collapsed.suggestion: Turn off log collapsing in options if you need every line.

log_truncated.suggestion: Filter the log by time range or level before converting.

markup_partial.suggestion: Check the raw spans, or convert from the original source format if available.

mdx_components_stripped.suggestion: Convert the rendered HTML page instead if components carry essential content.

media_unavailable.suggestion: Upload the media file directly, or use the browser extension or share sheet.

merged_cells_flattened.suggestion: Use the full profile with merged_cells=html to keep spans as an HTML table.

misnamed_file.suggestion: Rename the file with the extension of its real format.

missing_resource.suggestion: Include the attachments folder in the upload.

msg_partial.suggestion: Install the nonfree extra for full MSG support, or save the message as EML.

multilingual_content.suggestion: Pass --lang to pin the primary language if downstream tools need a single one.

multipage_article.suggestion: Check the page joins, or pass the site's single-page or print URL.

music_summary_only.suggestion: Force transcription in the media options if the file contains speech.

nesting_flattened.suggestion: No action needed; the text is complete, only the deepest indentation was merged.

no_speech_detected.suggestion: Check the file has an audio track with speech; set the language if it is quiet speech.

notebook_invalid.suggestion: Open and re-save the notebook in Jupyter to repair it.

ocr_confidence_low.suggestion: Upload a higher-resolution scan (300 DPI or more) or try a layout OCR engine.

ocr_unavailable.suggestion: Install the ocr extra, e.g. pip install 'intomd[ocr]', or use an instance with OCR enabled.

ole_object_skipped.suggestion: Extract the embedded object from the source and convert it separately.

orphan_thread_replies.suggestion: Include the full export or channel history so parents can be matched.

other.suggestion: Read the message and sidecar details; report it so a specific code can be added.

page_cap_reached.suggestion: Convert the document in page ranges, or raise the page cap on a self-hosted instance.

page_timeout.suggestion: Convert the listed pages separately, or self-host on faster hardware or a GPU.

pages_estimated.suggestion: Cite by section heading rather than page number.

pages_without_text.suggestion: Enable OCR or upload a text-layer PDF.

paywall_detected.suggestion: Save the page from a logged-in browser and upload it, or use the browser extension.

phi_possible.suggestion: Review and redact before sharing, and self-host for regulated data.

phi_refused.suggestion: Self-host intomd to process health records under your own compliance controls.

pii_columns_removed.suggestion: Turn off PII column removal in data options if you are permitted to keep those columns.

possible_serial_dates.suggestion: Apply a date format to those cells in the source workbook.

private_link.suggestion: Share the file as 'Anyone with the link can view', or export it and upload the file.

private_post.suggestion: Save the post from a logged-in browser and upload it, or use the browser extension.

profanity_masked.suggestion: Turn off profanity masking in the transcript options to keep the original words.

quoted_history_removed.suggestion: Turn off quoted-history stripping in email options to keep it.

ragged_rows.suggestion: Check the source for missing delimiters or stray cells.

rate_limited.suggestion: Wait a few minutes and retry, or configure your own API credentials.

readability_fallback_full_body.suggestion: Expect navigation text; use the extension's selection mode to convert only the article.

reading_order_uncertain.suggestion: Try a layout-aware engine such as --engine pdf=docling, and check column order.

receipt_totals_mismatch.suggestion: Check the flagged values against the receipt; rescan if digits are blurred.

reconciliation_failed.suggestion: Review the flagged page against the source; try a layout OCR engine for scans.

removed_hidden_elements.suggestion: Inspect the original source if the hidden content matters to you.

removed_running_header_footer.suggestion: Use the full profile with page provenance if you need page boundaries.

removed_script_or_macro.suggestion: Open the source in its native app if you need to review the macro code.

robots_disallowed.suggestion: Save the page in your browser and upload it, or use the browser extension.

row_cap_reached.suggestion: Use the CSV export for every row, or raise the row cap in options.

rows_sampled.suggestion: Use the CSV export for every row.

secret_file_excluded.suggestion: No action needed; rename the file if it was wrongly detected as a secret.

secret_redacted.suggestion: No action needed; rotate the secret if the source was shared anywhere.

sitemap_truncated.suggestion: Raise the site page limit, or narrow the crawl with an include pattern.

size_cap.suggestion: Split the input into smaller files, or self-host with a higher size cap.

slide_cap_reached.suggestion: Split the deck, or raise office.max_slides when self-hosting.

smartart_flattened.suggestion: Check the source if the diagram's layout carries meaning.

smime_not_decrypted.suggestion: Decrypt the message in your mail client and export the decrypted copy.

spec_invalid.suggestion: Validate the spec with an OpenAPI linter, fix the errors, and reconvert.

sqlite_encrypted.suggestion: Decrypt the database (e.g. with SQLCipher) and upload the plain copy.

structure_tree_unusable.suggestion: Re-export the PDF with accessibility tagging for more reliable headings.

suggestions_not_exported.suggestion: Download the doc as DOCX to keep suggestions as tracked changes, then convert that.

table_inferred.suggestion: Check the inferred table against the source text.

table_rejoined.suggestion: Check the rejoined table at the page break against the source.

table_sampled.suggestion: Use the table's CSV export for every row.

table_structure_uncertain.suggestion: Check the table against the source, or try a layout-aware engine.

teams_html_best_effort.suggestion: Use a Teams JSON export (Purview or Graph) for reliable structure.

textbox_content_relocated.suggestion: Check relocated text box content against the source layout.

thread_partial_federation.suggestion: Open the thread on its home server to convert remote replies.

thread_reconstructed_from_text.suggestion: Export with full headers (EML or MBOX) for reliable threading.

timeout_hard.suggestion: Split the input into smaller parts, or self-host with a longer timeout.

timeout_partial.suggestion: Retry with a smaller input or fewer pages, or raise the job timeout when self-hosting.

timestamps_approximate.suggestion: Use server-side ASR with word timestamps if you need precise timing.

timezone_assumed.suggestion: Pass the source timezone in options if the timestamps are local time.

tnef_unparsed.suggestion: Ask the sender to resend in plain or HTML format, or decode it with a TNEF tool.

token_budget_applied.suggestion: Raise max_tokens or narrow the include globs to the files you need.

tos_risk_source.suggestion: Make sure your use complies with the platform's terms; prefer an official export.

tracked_changes_present.suggestion: Set track_changes=all to keep insertions and deletions as CriticMarkup.

truncated.suggestion: Raise max_tokens or page through the result with the cursor, or self-host with a higher cap.

unreadable_region.suggestion: Upload a sharper, higher-resolution scan of the marked region.

unresolved_users.suggestion: Include the export's users file (e.g. users.json) in the upload.

unresolved_wikilinks.suggestion: Upload the whole vault folder so links can resolve.

unsupported_feature.suggestion: Export the source to a simpler format (PDF, DOCX, HTML) that keeps the feature, then reconvert.

url_blocked_by_policy.suggestion: Upload the content as a file, or contact the instance operator if this is a mistake.

verbatim_mode.suggestion: Turn off verbatim mode for a cleaner, more readable transcript.

versions_skipped.suggestion: Pass the versioned URL prefix to convert a specific version.

word_index_dropped.suggestion: Convert the index pages separately if you need them.

xbrl_statement_mismatch.suggestion: Compare the flagged values with the filing's official XBRL viewer.

xfa_partial.suggestion: Print the form to PDF from Adobe Reader to flatten it, then convert that copy.

yaml_unsafe_tags.suggestion: Remove language-specific tags such as !!python/object from the YAML.
